acceptance_criterion: All six independence gates plus semantic and authority ownership are evidenced.
definition: A governed outcome promise to a defined user with independent adoption, operation, support, economic accountability, lifecycle and exit.
falsifier: A missing exit, support owner or separable job falsifies product status.

acceptance_criterion: Referenced through requirement/offer contracts.
definition: A selectable behavior offered by one or more products.
falsifier: A capability does not become a product because it is configurable.

acceptance_criterion: Owned and released as an implementation unit.
definition: A code or deployment subdivision hidden behind a product contract.
falsifier: No direct user outcome, support or exit promise exists.

acceptance_criterion: Publishes types, traits, laws and removal seams.
definition: A reusable semantic or algorithmic implementation unit.
falsifier: A crate/package name cannot own a product promise.

acceptance_criterion: Run the same six gates as any product.
definition: A computational component; it is a product only if independently embedded/adopted and carries lifecycle, correctness, support and exit promises.
falsifier: Performance or algorithmic novelty alone is insufficient.

acceptance_criterion: Must expose spec/status, refusal, convergence, authority and recovery contracts.
definition: A desired-state, policy or reconciliation authority.
falsifier: A controller binary without independently adopted service posture is a module.

acceptance_criterion: May be a product only when consumers can adopt, allocate, support and exit it independently.
definition: An operated reusable service consumed by several products.
falsifier: Internal reach or many callers alone is insufficient.

acceptance_criterion: Qualification evidence is scoped by version, target, region and time.
definition: A replaceable implementation or resource occurrence satisfying a typed offer.
falsifier: A vendor or infrastructure resource is not automatically the product that consumes it.

acceptance_criterion: Entitlements and cross-product experience are explicit; semantic owners remain below.
definition: Commercial or navigational packaging over products.
falsifier: A suite never acquires all meanings of its contents.

acceptance_criterion: Compiles through typed imports and may span industries.
definition: A reusable composition of products, mappings, rules, methods and acceptance tests for a class of problems.
falsifier: It does not become a horizontal engine or re-own imported semantics.

acceptance_criterion: Industry terms remain owned by vertical domains and are mapped through ACLs.
definition: Vertical vocabulary, cases, sources, rules and authority bindings composed with horizontal products.
falsifier: Changing industry may not require changing horizontal owned meanings.

acceptance_criterion: May be an experience product if adoption/support/exit are independent.
definition: A deployed user-facing composition for a bounded workflow.
falsifier: A UI is not proof of an independent product boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Exact cuts, ports, semantics, quality and exit are explicit.
definition: A governed, addressable, independently valuable analytical publication with owner, contract, SLO, access and lifecycle.
falsifier: A table, topic or file without the promise is only an asset or port.

acceptance_criterion: Maps many-to-many to product identities.
definition: A price or entitlement package.
falsifier: Vendor packaging is implementation evidence, never boundary authority.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: A consumer makes a separable adoption decision and reaches value through a stable contract.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: Health, capacity, failure, recovery and on-call responsibility are attributable to this promise.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: Supported versions, severity, response and consumer/provider responsibilities are published.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: Usage and shared cost can be attributed without using repository or team proxies.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: State, configuration, identity, evidence and active obligations can move to a substitute.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.

acceptance_criterion: Named evidence exists and a negative/adversarial twin fails for the expected reason.
definition: Owned meanings and effect authority are unique and published through stable interfaces.
falsifier: The gate is asserted only from a vendor SKU, team, repository, deployment or bounded-context boundary.
